eventMetadata.context_description: **Current short-range numerical weather prediction models and ensemble guidance position mid-30s Celsius as the most probable range for Qingdao’s maximum temperature on August 2, 2026.** Clear skies under a subtropical high-pressure ridge, combined with light southerly flow and minimal cloud cover, support daytime heating toward 35–37 °C, while the moderating influence of the Yellow Sea caps extreme values. Recent model runs show limited spread, with deterministic solutions clustering near 36 °C and ensemble members placing the bulk probability between 35 °C and 37 °C. Low precipitation probability (<10 %) and dew-point temperatures in the low-to-mid 20s further favor efficient surface warming. Traders therefore assign the highest implied probabilities to 36 °C (42.5 %) and 37 °C (26.5 %), reflecting consensus on these thermodynamic and synoptic conditions while acknowledging residual uncertainty from possible sea-breeze timing or minor convective development.
